Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 30 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 61 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree

Scene 1: The fields - Day

[Rajesh stands in the fields. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Rajesh: "Today feels like a good day."

[A cobra bites Rajesh and he dies in the fields.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "We will never forget you."
